name: Gumloop
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Gumloop, build one AI-assisted workflow from user-approved files and APIs. The hard boundary is hosted agent runtime, model routing, connectors, browser operations, and collaboration, plus connector breadth and execution reliability.
